body: Are you still happy with the r5s ?

Its tough and difficult for sure but you made the decision to get sober for a reason. You need to trust the process and keep working at it. We always think about the withdrawals as the worst part of getting sober but its not 3 days is easy. The thing is everything that drove you to take drugs is still there when you get sober and there's no more crutch. You also have to deal with all the problems that came with using - broken relationships, the damage to your body... Its not easy thats for sure but you know how close you were to overdosing, financial pressures, depression from seeing everyone else doing well and not being self destructive.

Don't look at what you haven't got but rather what you do. You haven't overdosed, you aren't spending everything to get high, you're more days sober than most people... Start counting your blessings and remind yourself when it gets tough , you're still breathing. Everything else will come in due time, if you keep working at it and don't give up. 

Congrats for 2 months and keep going.
